card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 stops lifting the sofa; A3 redirects sound to apology and A5 explicitly forbids checking in favor of reassurance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 jingling gives A3 supposed responsiveness; B4 conditional apology with checking prompts A5 no checking and trust.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies direct location evidence and B4 agrees partly while retaining a sensible search step.

heightening.evidence: B4 keeps the ordinary explanation alive through inspection; A5 removes that escape and deepens exclusive emotional negotiation.

specificity.evidence: A1 lost keys under a sofa and B2 cushion jingling make the competing explanations concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 ready to come out earns its patient-key personification from the refusal to look beneath the cushion.
